description: Land Title Settlement Department - Sippikulama, Hambantota D/S Division, Hambantota District  and other Title Settlements
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, block numbers, cadastral map references, and location details) in Sippikulama village. The content includes detailed schedules showing land ownership determinations (all parcels assigned to "The States"), extents, and title classifications. This falls squarely under Land Gazettes (Type 4) as it concerns land registration, title determination, and property ownership matters.
